answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 43944 Country: India Title: Umrah Question: I am living in Saudi Arabia and used to go for Umrah quite often. If we do Umrah 3-4 times in a year; (1) It is permissible not to do halaq but a regular hair cutting? (2) If not done halaq as in the past, what are the consequences of living with wife? (3) What should be done before going for next Umrah if last Umrah was not done properly? Answer ID: 43944 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 357/261/D=1434) (1) If the hair is longer than one finger tip then it is correct to cut it equal to one finger tip. But if the hair is shorter than one finger tip then it is necessary to shave it. This is necessary after each Umrah. (2) It is haram. Dam (slaughtering of animal) shall be wajib. (3) Why it was not valid, write the complete detail. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
